title: Reconstruction:Proto-West Germanic/fallijan
extract:
== Proto-West Germanic ==


=== Etymology ===
From Proto-Germanic *fallijaną.


=== Verb ===
*fallijan

to cause to fall, to fell


==== Inflection ====


==== Related terms ====
*fallan


==== Descendants ====
Old English: fellan, fiellan
Middle English: fellen
Scots: fell
English: fell
Old Frisian: fella, falla
West Frisian: falle
Old Saxon: fellian
Middle Low German: vellen
Low German: fällen
Old Dutch: *fellen
Middle Dutch: vellen
Dutch: vellen
Afrikaans: vel
Old High German: fellen
Middle High German: vellen
German: fällen
